scope: Actual advisory typed judgments; independent PStack prose review and tests remain required. No release approval.

correctness_concern.instructions: Is an evident reachable correctness defect present in this experimental source?

criteria.true: Concrete invariant violation, wrong labels/scoring, unsafe load, identity bypass or false qualification.
criteria.false: No evident defect; unexecuted GPU behavior is unknown, not proven correct.

security_concern.instructions: Does this source evidently cross its trust boundary?

criteria.true: Raw model code execution, authority grant, unsafe deserialization, path escape, credential disclosure, or accepting malformed artifacts.
criteria.false: Bounded untrusted advice, deterministic checks, operator-controlled synthetic experiments.

evidence_concern.instructions: Does this source claim synthetic or unexecuted work qualifies model quality or release?

criteria.true: Mocks or unexecuted experiments are presented as measured real quality or production qualification.
criteria.false: Source, synthetic limits, measured records and remaining actual-runtime gates are distinguished.

billing: Existing authenticated tool used; no billing settings changed; charges not independently verified.
